ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious RunAs-Like Flag Combination
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious command line flags that let the user set a target user and command as e.g. seen in PsExec-like tools

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ system\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-user\\ system\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ NT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ \\"NT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ \\'NT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-system\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ administrator\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ \\"cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ \\"powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-command\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-command\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ whoami.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ cscript.*")))
